question: Find all patients who were admitted to the hospital and have at least one laboratory test with either abnormal anti-SM results or GOT levels outside the normal range. For these patients, return their ID, sex, current age, and the number of distinct years in which they had such abnormal laboratory tests.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T1."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    T1."XCL_059" AS sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS current_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_015")) AS distinct_abnormal_years
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_058"
    FROM Patient AS T3
    INNER JOIN Examination AS T4 ON T3."XCL_058" = T4."XCL_001"
    WHERE T4."XCL_013" > 0
)
AND (
    T2."XCL_052" NOT IN ('0', 'negative')
    OR T2."XCL_023" > 40
)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_059", T1."XCL_060"

measures.eligibility_application: Only laboratory tests that are abnormal (anti-SM positive or GOT > 40) are counted.
